section.content: 为克服现有三电极体系应用于动力电池检测性能不足的问题，本实用新型提供了一种锂离子电池，包括封装容器以及封装于所述封装容器中的电芯和参比电极，所述电芯包括层叠的正极片、负极片和第一隔膜，所述正极片和所述负极片由所述第一隔膜相互分隔，所述电芯的最外层为第一隔膜，所述参比电极设置于所述电芯的外侧，所述正极片，所述负极片和所述参比电极由所述封装容器电引出。本实用新型提供的锂离子电池有利于提高参比电极的测试稳定性，同时，在保持电池极芯的成型方式不变的情况下，降低加工难度。

For overcoming the current problem that the three electrode system is applied to power battery detection performance not enough, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, including packaging container and encapsulate in electric core and reference electrode among the packaging container, electric core includes range upon range of positive plate, negative pole piece and first diaphragm, positive plate with the negative pole piece by first diaphragm separates each other, the outmost first diaphragm that is of electric core, the reference electrode set up in the outside of electric core, positive plate, the negative pole piece with the reference electrode by the packaging container electricity is drawn forth. The utility model provides a lithium ion battery is favorable to improving reference electrode's test stability, simultaneously, under the unchangeable condition of the shaping mode that keeps the battery utmost point core, reduces the processing degree of difficulty.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of secondary battery, concretely relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

With the serious aggravation of the global environmental pollution problem, the new energy automobile is highly valued by governments, automobile enterprises and scientific research institutions in the world, and the electric energy is a main power source of the new energy automobile and has the advantage of reducing the emission. The power battery is used as a core component of a new energy automobile, the electrochemical performance of the power battery is subject to a plurality of factors, and the test and evaluation are limited, so that how to monitor the battery performance in real time without affecting the cycle performance and the health state of the battery is a technical problem to be solved by a person skilled in the art.

In the process of charge and discharge circulation, the battery is influenced by temperature, charge and discharge process steps and internal active materials, and after certain circulation process steps, the phenomena of capacity attenuation and the like may occur, but only a double-electrode system is adopted for detection, the state of the whole full battery can only be analyzed, and a certain core 'component' cannot be refined, in order to better analyze the respective influence of the positive electrode and the negative electrode in the battery, the existing solution is to introduce a third electrode, namely a reference electrode, and the respective working states of the positive electrode and the negative electrode in the battery can be effectively analyzed by monitoring and analyzing the potential change of the positive electrode and the negative electrode relative to the third electrode.

Through the design of the three-electrode system, researchers can better evaluate the electrochemical reaction of the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the battery in the charging and discharging processes. The three-electrode system of the power battery is designed, so that the change of the voltage potential of the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the battery relative to the reference electrode in the charging and discharging process can be effectively monitored, the respective working states of the positive electrode and the negative electrode in the circulating process can be distinguished, and qualitative analysis can be carried out on the positive electrode and the negative electrode.

However, the existing three-electrode structure is not suitable for a power battery system, and at the same time, the current three-electrode structure cannot completely simulate the circulation state of a substitute power battery in actual operation, so that a three-electrode system based on the power battery is urgently needed to be designed, and the state change of the battery electrode of a new energy motor vehicle in the running process can be reflected more accurately.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Be applied to the problem that power battery detection performance is not enough to current three-electrode system, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery.

The utility model provides an above-mentioned technical problem adopted technical scheme as follows:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, including packaging container and encapsulate in electric core and reference electrode among the packaging container, electric core is including range upon range of positive plate, negative pole piece and first diaphragm, positive plate with the negative pole piece by first diaphragm separates each other, the outmost first diaphragm that is of electric core, the reference electrode set up in the outside of electric core, positive plate, the negative pole piece with the reference electrode by the packaging container electricity is drawn forth.

Optionally, a second diaphragm is wrapped outside the reference electrode, and the second diaphragm is fixed to the first diaphragm on the outermost layer of the battery core.

Optionally, the packaging container includes a cover plate and a metal casing, the battery cell is disposed in the metal casing, the metal casing is provided with an opening, and the cover plate encapsulates the opening of the metal casing.

Optionally, a reference electrode column is arranged on the cover plate, and a first conductor is arranged between the reference electrode column and the reference electrode to be electrically connected with each other.

Optionally, the reference electrode is electrically connected to the metal housing.

Optionally, a positive post and a negative post are arranged on the cover plate, a second conductor is arranged between the positive plate and the positive post and is electrically connected with each other, and a third conductor is arranged between the negative plate and the negative post and is electrically connected with each other.

Optionally, the positive plate includes a positive current collector and a positive material layer, a positive coating area and a positive blank area are formed on the positive current collector, and the positive material layer is coated on the positive coating area;

the negative pole piece includes negative pole mass flow body and negative pole material layer, be formed with negative coating district and negative pole blank region on the negative pole mass flow body, the negative pole material layer coat in on the negative coating district.

Optionally, the battery cell is formed by laminating the positive plate, the negative plate and the first diaphragm, the positive coating area and the negative coating area are mutually stacked, and the positive blank area and the negative blank area are led out from the same end of the battery cell.

Optionally, the battery cell is formed by winding the positive plate, the negative plate and the first diaphragm, the positive coating area and the negative coating area are stacked and then wound, the positive blank area and the negative blank area are respectively located at two ends of the battery cell, the positive blank area is welded into a whole after being wound, the first nickel plate is welded at the outer side of the positive blank area, and the positive plate is electrically led out by the first nickel plate; the negative pole blank region is welded into a whole after being wound, a second nickel sheet is welded on the outer side of the negative pole blank region, and the negative pole sheet is electrically led out from the second nickel sheet.

Optionally, the reference electrode includes the reference mass flow body and lithium iron phosphate layer, be formed with reference coating area and reference blank area on the reference mass flow body, the lithium iron phosphate layer coat in reference coating area, the welding of reference blank area has the third nickel piece, the reference electrode by the electricity of third nickel piece is drawn forth.

According to the utility model provides a lithium ion battery adopts the positive plate first diaphragm with the range upon range of formation electric core of negative plate, set up the reference electrode simultaneously in on the outmost first diaphragm of electric core, can effectively avoid the influence each other between reference electrode and positive plate and the negative plate, improve reference electrode test stability, satisfy power battery's detection requirement. Meanwhile, the reference electrode is arranged on the outer side of the battery core, so that the electrical property of the reference electrode is favorably led out, and the processing difficulty is reduced under the condition that the forming mode of the battery pole core is not changed.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical problem, technical solution and advantageous effects solved by the present invention more clearly understood, the following description is given in conjunction with the accompanying drawings and embodiments to further explain the present invention in detail. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the invention and are not intended to limit the invention.

Referring to fig. 1 to 6, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, which includes a packaging container, and a battery cell 3 and a reference electrode 4 packaged in the packaging container.

As shown in fig. 5, the battery cell 3 includes a positive electrode sheet 31, a negative electrode sheet 32, and a first separator 33, which are stacked, the positive electrode sheet and the negative electrode sheet are separated from each other by the first separator, and the first separator 33 is located between the positive electrode sheet 31 and the negative electrode sheet 32 to prevent the positive electrode sheet 31 and the negative electrode sheet 32 from directly contacting each other.

As shown in fig. 3, the outermost layer of the battery cell 3 is a first diaphragm 33, the reference electrode 4 is disposed on the outer side of the battery cell 3, and the positive electrode tab 31, the negative electrode tab 32 and the reference electrode 4 are electrically led out from the packaging container.

Lithium ion battery adopts positive plate 31 first diaphragm 33 with negative pole piece 32 is range upon range of and is formed electric core 3, set up reference electrode 4 simultaneously in on the outmost first diaphragm 33 of electric core 3, can effectively avoid the influence each other between reference electrode 4 and positive plate 31 and the negative pole piece 32, improve reference electrode 4 test stability, satisfy power battery's detection requirement. Meanwhile, the reference electrode 4 is arranged on the outer side of the battery core 3, so that the electrical property of the reference electrode 4 is favorably led out, and the processing difficulty is reduced under the condition that the forming mode of the battery pole core is not changed.

In one embodiment, an electrolytic matrix is disposed in the containment vessel.

Specifically, the electrolyte matrix is in a solid state, a liquid state or a gel state.

When the electrolyte matrix is in a solid state or a gel state, the electrolyte matrix is located between the positive electrode tab 31 and the negative electrode tab 32.

When the electrolyte matrix is in a liquid state, the whole battery cell 3 is soaked in the electrolyte matrix.

As shown in fig. 3, in an embodiment, the reference electrode 4 is externally wrapped by a second membrane 44, and the second membrane 44 is fixed on the first membrane 33 at the outermost layer of the cell 3.

Through the second diaphragm 44, the reference electrode 4 can be protected, the reference electrode 4 is prevented from being in electrical contact with the positive plate 31 or the negative plate 32 of the battery cell 3, the safety of the reference electrode 4 is ensured, meanwhile, the reference electrode 4 can be effectively ensured to be in full contact with an electrolytic matrix, and further, the stability of the reference electrode 4 is improved.

In an embodiment, the packaging container includes a cover plate 1 and a metal shell 2, the battery cell 3 is disposed in the metal shell 2, the metal shell 2 is provided with an opening, and the cover plate 1 encapsulates the opening of the metal shell 2.

The metal shell 2 is an aluminum shell.

As shown in fig. 1, in an embodiment of the present invention, a reference electrode column 13 is disposed on the cover plate 1, and the reference electrode column 13 and the reference electrode 4 are electrically connected to each other by a first conductor 5.

The first conductor 5 is a metal material.

More preferably, the first conductor 5 is a metal conducting strip or a metal conducting wire, and in some embodiments, the outer periphery of the first conductor 5 is provided with an insulating layer to avoid electrical contact with the metal shell or the battery cell 3.

In another embodiment of the present invention, as shown in fig. 2, the reference electrode 4 is electrically connected to the metal case 2.

Through with reference electrode 4 with metal casing 2 electricity is connected, can effectively reduce the equipment degree of difficulty, when carrying out the three-electrode test, only need with testing arrangement electricity connect metal casing 2 can, be favorable to the researcher to carry out pertinence improvement and research to the battery better.

As shown in fig. 1 and 2, in some embodiments, a positive post 11 and a negative post 12 are disposed on the cover plate 1, the positive tab 31 is electrically connected to the positive post 11 via a second conductor 6, and the negative tab 32 is electrically connected to the negative post 12 via a third conductor 7.

The second conductor 6 is a metal material.

More preferably, the second conductor 6 is a metal conductive sheet or a metal wire, and in some embodiments, the outer circumference of the second conductor 6 is provided with an insulating layer to avoid electrical contact with the metal housing.

As shown in fig. 3, in an embodiment, the positive electrode sheet 31 includes a positive electrode collector 311 and a positive electrode material layer 312, a positive electrode coating area 3112 and a positive electrode blank area 3111 are formed on the positive electrode collector 311, and the positive electrode material layer 312 is coated on the positive electrode coating area 3112.

The positive electrode material layer 312 includes a positive electrode active material, and optionally, the positive electrode material layer 312 further includes a positive electrode binder and a positive electrode conductive agent, the positive electrode active material, the positive electrode binder and the positive electrode conductive agent are mixed with each other by a solvent to form a positive electrode slurry, and the positive electrode slurry is disposed on the positive electrode coating region 3112 in a layer shape and dried to remove the solvent, so as to obtain the positive electrode material layer 312.

The negative plate 32 comprises a negative current collector 321 and a negative material layer 322, a negative coating area 3212 and a negative blank area 3211 are formed on the negative current collector 321, and the negative material layer 322 is coated on the negative coating area 3212.

The negative electrode material layer 322 includes a negative electrode active material, and optionally, the negative electrode material layer 322 further includes a negative electrode binder and a negative electrode conductive agent, the negative electrode active material, the negative electrode binder and the negative electrode conductive agent are mixed with each other by a solvent to form a negative electrode slurry, and the negative electrode slurry is disposed on the negative electrode coating region 3212 in a layered manner and dried to remove the solvent, so as to obtain the negative electrode material layer 322.

As shown in fig. 4, in an embodiment, the battery cell 3 is formed by winding the positive electrode sheet 31, the negative electrode sheet 32 and the first separator 33, the positive electrode coating region 3112 and the negative electrode coating region 3212 are stacked and then wound, and the positive electrode blank region 3111 and the negative electrode blank region 3211 are respectively located at two ends of the battery cell 3.

Anodal blank 3111 is used for being connected in order to draw forth anodal electric current with external electricity, negative pole blank 3211 is used for being connected in order to draw forth negative pole electric current with external electricity, through with anodal blank 3111 with negative pole blank 3211 set up respectively in the both ends of electric core 3, can effectively avoid positive plate 31 with the short circuit of negative pole piece 32.

In one embodiment, the positive blank space 3111 is welded into a whole after being wound, a first nickel sheet 313 is welded on the outer side of the positive blank space 3111, and the positive sheet 31 is electrically led out from the first nickel sheet 313; the negative electrode blank 3211 is welded into a whole after being wound, a second nickel sheet 323 is welded to the outer side of the negative electrode blank 3211, and the negative electrode sheet 32 is electrically led out from the second nickel sheet 323.

The positive blank space 3111 is welded into a whole after being wound, and the negative blank space 3211 is welded into a whole after being wound, so that the internal resistance of the battery cell 3 can be effectively reduced.

The positive current collector 311 is made of aluminum foil, and the negative current collector 321 is made of copper foil.

Because the material of the anodal mass flow body 311 and the negative pole mass flow body 321 commonly used is not convenient for the welding operation, in this embodiment, through adopting first nickel piece 313 with anodal blank space 3111 welds, adopt second nickel piece 323 with the blank space 3211 welding of negative pole, first nickel piece 313 with second nickel piece 323 is as anodal mass flow body 311 with the electric connection welding position of negative pole mass flow body 321, nickel all have better welded intersolubility with various metals, can effectively improve welded stability, and the welding mode is argon arc welding, gas welding, electric welding, submerged arc automatic weld, gas shielded arc welding, ultrasonic welding or explosive welding.

In another embodiment (not shown), the battery cell 3 is formed by laminating the positive electrode sheet, the negative electrode sheet and the first separator, the positive electrode coating area and the negative electrode coating area are stacked, and the positive electrode blank area and the negative electrode blank area are led out from the same end of the battery cell.

As shown in fig. 6, in an embodiment, the reference electrode 4 includes a reference current collector 41 and a lithium iron phosphate layer 42, a reference coating area 412 and a reference blank area 411 are formed on the reference current collector 41, the reference blank area 411 is located the reference current collector 41 is close to one side of the positive blank area 3111, the lithium iron phosphate layer 42 is coated on the reference coating area 412, the reference blank area 411 is welded with a third nickel plate 43, and the reference electrode 4 is electrically led out from the third nickel plate 43.

The present invention will be described below with reference to a wound lithium ion battery as an example.

Example 1

This embodiment is used for disclosing the utility model provides a pair of lithium ion battery's preparation method, including following operating sequence:

(1) winding of the pole core:

obtaining a positive plate 31, a first diaphragm 33, a negative plate 32, a first nickel plate 313 and a second nickel plate 323; the positive electrode sheet 31, the first diaphragm 33 and the negative electrode sheet 32 are superposed once, so that the positive electrode blank space 3111 and the negative electrode blank space 3211 are oppositely arranged; then winding along the length direction of the positive plate 31 and the negative plate 32 to form a winding-shaped pole core, so that the positive blank space 3111 and the negative blank space 3211 are wound to form a multi-layer metal foil structure and are respectively positioned at two ends of the pole core as a positive pole lug and a negative pole lug;

welding a plurality of layers of the positive electrode blank space 3111 through the first nickel sheet 313; the second nickel sheet 323 is used for welding the plurality of layers of the cathode blank regions 3211 into a whole.

(2) Mounting of reference electrode 4:

the reference electrode 4 is wrapped by the second diaphragm 44 and then fixed on one side of the rolled electric core 3, and the reference blank area 411 of the reference electrode 4 is welded into a whole through the third nickel sheet 43.

(3) Packaging the power battery:

and (2) putting the battery cell 3 into an accommodating space formed by the metal shell 2 and the cover plate 1, wherein the cover plate 1 is provided with a positive pole column 11, a negative pole column 12 and a reference electrode column 13, the positive pole column 11 is electrically connected with the first nickel sheet 313, the negative pole column 12 is electrically connected with the second nickel sheet 323, the reference electrode column 13 is electrically connected with the third nickel sheet 43, and then electrolyte is injected inwards to obtain the lithium ion battery shown in fig. 1.

And carrying out formation and exhaust on the lithium ion battery, and then sealing the battery.

The lithium ion battery obtained in the embodiment 1 is subjected to a three-electrode GITT test, and the obtained test result is shown in fig. 7, and it can be seen from fig. 7 that the lithium ion battery structure provided in this embodiment can effectively ensure the stability of the three-electrode test of the lithium ion battery.

Example 2

This embodiment is used for disclosing the utility model provides a pair of lithium ion battery's preparation method, including following operating sequence:

(1) winding of the pole core:

obtaining a positive plate 31, a first diaphragm 33, a negative plate 32, a first nickel plate 313 and a second nickel plate 323; the positive electrode sheet 31, the first diaphragm 33 and the negative electrode sheet 32 are superposed once, so that the positive electrode blank space 3111 and the negative electrode blank space 3211 are oppositely arranged; then winding along the length direction of the positive plate 31 and the negative plate 32 to form a winding-shaped pole core, so that the positive blank space 3111 and the negative blank space 3211 are wound to form a multi-layer metal foil structure and are respectively positioned at two ends of the pole core as a positive pole lug and a negative pole lug;

welding a plurality of layers of the positive electrode blank space 3111 through the first nickel sheet 313; the second nickel sheet 323 is used for welding the plurality of layers of the cathode blank regions 3211 into a whole.

(2) Mounting of reference electrode 4:

the reference electrode 4 is wrapped by the second diaphragm 44 and then fixed on one side of the rolled electric core 3, and the reference blank area 411 of the reference electrode 4 is welded into a whole through the third nickel sheet 43.

(3) Packaging the power battery:

and (2) placing the battery cell 3 into an accommodating space formed by the metal shell 2 and the cover plate 1, wherein the cover plate 1 is provided with a positive post 11 and a negative post 12, the positive post 11 is electrically connected with the first nickel sheet 313, the negative post 12 is electrically connected with the second nickel sheet 323, the third nickel sheet 43 and the metal shell 2 are welded into a whole, and then electrolyte is injected inwards to obtain the lithium ion battery shown in fig. 2.

And carrying out formation and exhaust on the lithium ion battery, and then sealing the battery.

The lithium ion battery obtained in the embodiment 2 is subjected to a three-electrode GITT test, and the obtained test result is shown in fig. 8, and it can be seen from fig. 8 that the lithium ion battery structure provided in this embodiment can effectively ensure the stability of the three-electrode test of the lithium ion battery.

The above description is only exemplary of the present invention and should not be taken as limiting the scope of the present invention, as any modifications, equivalents, improvements and the like made within the spirit and principles of the present invention are intended to be included within the scope of the present invention.
